materiality.rationale: Owner-delegated engineering caps frozen before paired Mortis diagnostic outputs: BOTH p50 <= OCR +1000ms and <=1.05*OCR; BOTH p95 <= OCR +2000ms and <=1.10*OCR, independently for PR/security and each declared stratum. Separate five-repetition OCR-only quiet-Docker calibration observed PR p50 20.180s (spread 0.327s), security p50 5.647s (spread 0.653s). Noise requires more independent paired evidence rather than wider margins; an additional 10s dispatcher tick is a meaningful regression. Calibration has only one visible family per workload and is not acceptance. No existing pilot ratio determined these caps.

bootstrap.minimum_families_source: Legacy source-family inference floor only. New performance inference uses independent execution blocks with its own >=20 floor; finite-corpus quality separately declares >=19 actual source families.

strata_rationale: Live quality is limited to the independently reviewed frozen source corpus, once per case with graph off and no source pre-read. Source-cache pre-reading is a performance intervention, not extra accuracy evidence. Graph/source-inclusion functionality remains separately required. Controlled performance crosses all twelve PR/security x graph off/on/gap x cold/warm cells, with both the fixed profile mixture and each profile required to pass.
quality_rule: Owner-approved prospective amendment: exact no-regression in observed precision and recall on the independently reviewed frozen corpus, all confirmed high/critical defects retained, all planned work and reliability gates complete. Family confidence bounds are descriptive; degenerate or imprecise bounds do not establish population parity. Original pilot rules/results remain unchanged. Performance confidence thresholds are unchanged.
latency_rule: For every controlled workload/graph/cache cell and each fixed profile within that cell, resample entire paired execution blocks, preserving the same complete case mixture and both arms. Compute differences of arm p50/p95 values inside each draw, then max(absolute_excess_ms,relative_excess_ms); require the nominal one-sided 95% upper excess <=0 with all twenty planned complete independent blocks and nondegenerate evidence. BOTH p50 1000ms/5% and BOTH p95 2000ms/10% remain mandatory. No profile/cell/percentile compensates another. No early pass, optional stopping, source-family relabeling or subtraction of overlapping provider durations.
consumption_rule: Freeze required request, total, input and output token counts; compare paired requests and total tokens, including all failures/retries. Preserve complete forwarded provider-event and durable ledger inventories: unfinished/unknown dispatch, inconsistent/missing token counts and unknown/reserved ledger usage block acceptance even when top-level totals look known. Optional invoice USD, cache and reasoning breakdowns remain descriptive unknowns when unreported; never replace them with zero or claim measured billing. Every declared finite cap additionally requires a known observable metric and remains enforced; the owner-selected current aggregate policy is explicitly uncapped, with no USD cap. Effective stage/resource/deadline limits remain bound separately by the frozen execution profile.
authorization: Owner approved finite-corpus quality and conditional frozen-matrix block inference with unchanged nominal95% performance confidence/caps. Delegated engineering judgment selects fixed20 blocks before acceptance outputs. Final immutable seal and independent scope/evidence audit remain required before this execution; public adoption is not authorized.
signoff_authority: Owner explicitly selected agent signoff. Fresh designated reviewers must be outside implementation and truth authoring, arm-blinded, and cover the entire packet through actual bound judgment documents. Never label agent review as human/external-expert review.

performance_measurement.limitations: External provider latency excluded by deterministic local responses and zero configured delay. Tiny local synthetic response processing, loopback round trips and observer overhead remain included; measured server wait is retained diagnostically, never subtracted from overlapping provider duration sums.

pr.repetition_rationale: One paired execution of every fixed profile/cell in each of twenty prospectively frozen complete independent execution blocks. Repetitions are execution blocks, not independent source families.

security.repetition_rationale: One paired execution of every fixed profile/cell in each of twenty prospectively frozen complete independent execution blocks. Repetitions are execution blocks, not independent source families.

performance_fixture_rule: Separate visible truth-free performance plan, cases and paired schedule; no heldout quality truth enters performance workers. Freeze expected_work counts per case (findings, assessment_candidates, historical_verification_targets, source_files, security_analysis_tasks). Include clean/single-file cases and designated nonempty assessment/history/cross-file cases in each workload, with a security case larger than frozen analysis_concurrency. Validate each measured case against its own declared counts and retained outcomes/tasks; do not force clean cases to produce findings. Pin semantically equivalent arm-specific response fixtures and unchanged effective limits. Block-mode v3 plans bind distinct profile_id values and explicit unique block_ids, with the same complete seeded-randomized case/arm schedule in every block. Each workload needs a real clean single-file profile and a real nonempty cross-file assessment/history profile; family_id remains provenance metadata, never the execution independence unit.
billing_limitation: This selected-provider prospective acceptance protocol rejects any nonnull aggregate_usd_cap because no observed invoice/billing binding exists; adding a numeric top-level cost claim cannot make such a cap enforceable. This is an evaluation-protocol limitation, not removal of production budget/cap features. Owner-selected aggregate request/token/USD caps remain explicitly null here; finite request/token limits and frozen per-stage/resource/deadline limits still fail closed on missing metrics or excess.

quality_acceptance.scope: No worse observed precision and recall on the independently reviewed sealed corpus in the two declared PR/security off/cold quality comparisons, once per source case. At least38 cases and19 actual source families per workload; family uncertainty is descriptive only. Undefined metrics, unresolved judgments, missing work, severe losses and reliability failures block. Source-cache pre-reads are not quality interventions; separate checks retain graph and source-inclusion features. Broader validation remains M6.

pr.repetition_rationale: One live paired accuracy evaluation per sealed source case. Cases sharing an actual source family remain clustered for descriptive quality uncertainty; no cache or graph repetitions manufacture new defects.

security.repetition_rationale: One live paired accuracy evaluation per sealed source case. Cases sharing an actual source family remain clustered for descriptive quality uncertainty; no cache or graph repetitions manufacture new defects.

performance_inference.sample_size_rationale: Delegated engineering choice for a bounded local experiment: fixed twenty complete blocks, two profiles per workload, all twelve workload/graph/cache cells, 960 arm executions (about six hours with the production polling interval). The user approved the paired-block approach and unchanged confidence/caps, not this exact N. N is selected prospectively by engineering before acceptance outcomes for practical runtime, not from observed acceptance latency. The inherited >=20 independent-unit floor is retained; no precision or power is established by this count.
limitations: The independent method review recommends sixty blocks for improved p95 tail resolution; delegated engineering judgment chooses twenty for the bounded experiment. Twenty observations/profile/cell make nearest-rank p95 the second largest; forty mixture observations/cell make it the third largest.

One-sided nominal 95% paired block percentile-bootstrap bounds retain the original confidence level and caps. They are approximate, not guaranteed exact finite-sample 95% coverage; small tail samples, atoms, drift and dependence can under-cover. More resamples do not add execution information.

Inference concerns repeated execution of this exact equal-weight fixed matrix on the frozen host/resource/cache setup. It does not establish population workload parity, all historical snapshots, external-provider latency or M6 readiness.

Each whole block must be independently reset and complete, with fixed cases and resource conditions and seeded random pair/arm order. Repetitions alone do not prove independence. Preserve reset/resource/timestamp evidence for independent review.

No early acceptance at a partial block count and no optional extension until pass. Missing work, invalid resources, failures, degenerate bounds and inconclusive bounds block acceptance. Keep every failed attempt and its usage; a later experiment needs its own prospective design.
